prompt: Use $spec-dev to fix a 500 response when a customer name contains an apostrophe. Normal names, email validation, and password validation must behave exactly as before.

expectedInvariants.statement: The agent distinguishes current, expected, and unchanged behavior.
The agent gathers reproduction or causal evidence before claiming a root cause.
Verification covers the corrected scenario and meaningful unchanged behavior.
The repair and its durable artifacts remain proportionate to the defect.

prohibitedBehaviors.statement: Labels a suspected code location as the proven root cause without evidence.
Treats the bugfix as a new feature without examining current expectations.
Reports verified when the reproduction or equivalent evidence was not exercised.
